title: parcelito
tagline: Buy, Create, and Gift Token Portfolios easily with just a few click!
description: Token baskets made simple even for newcomers to crypto. Made safe by verification of real humans, and having ENS and and 1inch under the hood, parcelito is a proof-of-concept app of what token baskets could be. Receive an email and claim a gift from someone who has bought a parcelito for you!
how_its_made: Anyone can claim gifts they receive from others, buy portfolios with one click, and gift to others. Making use of World ID, the app prevents scams by only letting verified humans create portfolios for users to buy. ENS is used for username and portfolio management. Simply buy and receive token portfolios using parcelito!
